title: Surat police arrest man accused of lending his bank account in a WhatsApp fake wedding-invitation APK fraud
date_note: The page gives no earlier day than its 27 November publication.
org: Surat City Police Cyber Crime Branch
geo_basis: city of the police branch that made the arrest, as the source states it
summary: According to khaskhabar.com, a Gujarat resident downloaded a fake APK sent on WhatsApp as a wedding invitation, and fraudsters then withdrew money from the victim's bank account. Surat city police's Cyber Crime Branch arrested a man from Bijnor district, Uttar Pradesh, who police say lent his bank account for a commission. Police urge caution with APK files received on WhatsApp.
plain: Surat police say a fake wedding-invitation app sent on WhatsApp let fraudsters take money from a victim's bank account. They arrested a man who allegedly lent his account to the fraudsters.
exec: Police in Surat report an arrest in a WhatsApp APK fraud; the report describes a fake wedding invitation used to take over a victim's phone.
action: Surat police advise caution with APK files received on WhatsApp or other platforms, and say financial cyber-fraud victims should call the National Cyber Crime Helpline at 1930.

validation.note: Single publisher (khaskhabar.com); the police's own statement was not read.

review.note: title, date, arrest in Bijnor, commission, police advice and 1930 helpline match khaskhabar
